name: Tengzhou
scopeLimits: This is city-source research, not a boundary or completeness assertion. No owner, address, tax, account, or other personal property data were requested or retained. No authentication, CAPTCHA, applicant form, or identifier-based property lookup was used. No full parcel polygons were retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: A Shandong Provincial Big Data Bureau publication names Tengzhou and describes Tengzhou municipal housing/real-estate systems that share data with its real-estate registration center, including digitized property-registration workflows and cadastral building survey data. This confirms a city-level registry function, but not parcel service coverage at the WUP point.
technicalBlocker: Official public sources establish a Tengzhou-linked real-estate registration function. No anonymously accessible parcel feature schema or geometry-only response was verified, so no polygon was retained.
remainingUncertainty: Whether Tengzhou publishes a separate local cadastre map/service that supports anonymous geometry-only export, and whether it covers the WUP point.
nextStep: If the official Tengzhou/ Zaozhuang map portal becomes discoverable, inspect layer metadata first and query only geometry plus a non-personal native ID.
